reason: The hypothesis applies the well-known strategy of substrate preheating to the specific cobalt-free AlCrFeNiSi high-entropy alloy, but this is a straightforward transfer of an established approach from tool steels (P14, P16, P21) and other alloys (P22, P24, P25, P28, P31, P39) to a new material without a stated reason why it should work differently or better, and the mechanism and predicted outcome are taken almost verbatim from the existing literature.
copied_elements: substrate preheating during laser additive manufacturing
reduces cooling rate and thermal gradients
mechanism: reduced thermal gradient slows cooling, decreases thermal contraction and residual stress
predicted outcome: lower residual stress, reduced defects, improved mechanical properties
